rows.note: This is the all-purpose verb for selling or guaranteeing more seats than are available.

example.english: The cinema chose to overbook tickets for the screening as a precaution.
example.traditional: 間戲院為咗保險，超賣咗場戲嘅飛。
example.jyutping: gaan1 hei3 jyun2 wai6 zo2 bou2 him2 ciu1 maai6 zo2 coeng4 hei3 ge3 fei1

rows.note: Use this colloquial phrasing when explicitly saying that too many tickets were sold, rather than merely guaranteed.

example.english: They managed to overbook by selling too many tickets, so some people had no seats on the day.
example.traditional: 佢哋賣多咗飛，入場嗰日有人冇位坐。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 maai6 do1 zo2 fei1 jap6 coeng4 go2 jat6 jau5 jan4 mou5 wai6 co5
